name: All infrastructure and digital services MUST be registered and identifiable, and all cloud resources MUST have Owner, CostCenter, and Env tags because this prevents the existence of unsecured, orphaned infrastructure.
requirementTitle: All infrastructure and digital services MUST be registered and identifiable, and all cloud resources MUST have Owner, CostCenter, and Env tags because this prevents the existence of unsecured, orphaned infrastructure.
requirementDescription: Every system, service, server, database, application, storage account, and cloud resource must be known, recorded, and clearly owned by someone. Cloud resources must also be tagged so they can be identified, managed, secured, and costed correctly.
why: Because this prevents the existence of unsecured infrastructure where it is unclear as to who owns it (orphaned resource). We cannot secure what we do not know exists. Orphaned infrastructure is a primary attack vector.
tasks: All infrastructure and digital services MUST be registered and identifiable, and all cloud resources MUST have Owner, CostCenter, and Env ta

actions.title: All infrastructure and digital services MUST be registered and identifiable, and all cloud resources MUST have Owner, CostCenter, and Env ta
actions.description: Resources shouldn't exist in the cloud that nobody owns, nobody pays for, and nobody is responsible for securing
